analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy decision (Aug 25), RSI rose from 40.4 to 43.7, attempting to exit oversold territory. Price recovered to $82.04 after updating the 5-day low to $78.60. MACD histogram stabilized at -0.8646, halting its decline. Although volume ratio is low at 0.65, the bounce after the 5-day low update strengthens the buy case. With weekly ADX at 15.9 indicating a lack of trend, potential for shock-like moves should be considered.
